categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing CIGU Technology Corp., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of magnetic levitation fluid machinery and core components such as magnetic levitation bearings, high-speed motors, and drives. Its main products include magnetic levitation centrifugal blowers, magnetic levitation air compressors, magnetic levitation chillers, magnetic levitation vacuum pumps, and magnetic levitation expansion power generation units (ORC). These products serve industries like wastewater treatment, chemical, textile, printing and dyeing, food, pharmaceuticals, paper, and electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include five-degree-of-freedom magnetic levitation bearings, high-power high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motors, dedicated high-speed motor frequency converters, high-speed efficient centrifugal impellers and flow components, and integrated high-speed equipment systems based on magnetic levitation bearings. Production methods involve advanced electromagnetic control, high-frequency vector modulation, and CAE/CFD fluid dynamics design, with a focus on energy efficiency, low noise, and maintenance-free operation. The company also employs a mix of in-house assembly and outsourced processing for non-core components.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial enterprises in sectors such as municipal wastewater treatment, chemical processing, textile manufacturing, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, paper production, electronics, metallurgy, and energy. The company’s products are widely used in both domestic and international markets, with significant penetration in China’s Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Shandong, Sichuan, Guangdong, and Xinjiang provinces, and expanding presence in Southeast Asia. Major customers include China National Petroleum, BOE Technology Group, Angel Yeast, Muyuan Foods, and Kingboard Holdings.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China, with sales covering all provinces and municipalities nationwide. It has also established an overseas business department to expand international markets, achieving significant growth in exports, especially in Southeast Asia. The company’s headquarters and main production facilities are located in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing CIGU Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of high-tech magnetic levitation fluid machinery and components. It procures raw materials and components such as electronic parts, cabinets, frequency converters, and impellers from upstream suppliers, while delivering finished products and integrated solutions directly to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation and R&D investment, focusing on new product development and pre-research of emerging technologies. Key R&D directions include expanding the product range of magnetic levitation air compressors, vacuum pumps, chillers, and ORC power generation units, improving product efficiency and stability, and developing high-voltage and high-power motor solutions. It also emphasizes digital transformation, intelligent control algorithms, and cloud-based equipment monitoring to enhance product competitiveness and customer service.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of magnetic levitation fluid machinery and related components. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by authorized distributors, with pricing based on production costs, market demand, and customer order specifics. Additionally, it earns income from contract energy management services, sharing energy savings with clients based on contractual agreements.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic brand in magnetic levitation fluid machinery, competing with international firms like SKF, Waukesha, IBAG, Sulzer, LTIMOTION, ZEITLOS, and NSK. It holds a strong position in China’s market with advanced proprietary technologies and a comprehensive product portfolio. The company benefits from national policies promoting energy efficiency and green technologies, positioning it favorably against traditional blower and compressor manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 478.5 million, a 15.7% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 51.5 million, up 7.16%. R&D expenses accounted for 9.17% of revenue, reflecting sustained investment in innovation. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.43 billion with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations. It maintains a stable financial position with ongoing expansion of production capacity and market reach.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing CIGU Technology emphasizes its magnetic levitation technology that enables frictionless transmission, high-speed operation, energy efficiency, low noise, and minimal maintenance. Its products offer significant energy savings compared to traditional equipment—approximately 25-30% for blowers, 20% for air compressors, 30-50% for chillers, and over 40% for vacuum pumps. The company’s integrated solutions, advanced control systems, and strong after-sales service provide customers with reliable, customized, and sustainable equipment tailored to diverse industrial applications.
